purpose: Five-session continuation probability, not 0-to-0 account win probability
population: Original fixed future-selected 1709 stock identities; original same-day CP1 receipt and ready, I target=1, E0/G ready, positive finite same-day close and factor, valid max(I floor,CP candidate) below close. No portfolio holdings, ACT, cap, industry stage or current cap gate.
PIT_limit: 1709 identities are future-selected; historical availability/ST/delist and adjustment publication time not certified. No claim of all historical A-share legal candidates.
event_id: sid plus signal day; root is original segment plus I-on episode, not account holding
label: Gross adjusted C[t+5]/adjusted raw O[t+1]-1 > 0. Five common sessions, all observations valid, same source segment. No inferred filling.
feature_clock: Signal close only; sigma and amount reference exclude signal day; market breadth same fixed pool, paired intersection for delta.
training: First signal day each month; trailing 252 common calendar days of signals, restricted to 2021 onward, maturity5 < first day index; all label horizons capped at 2026-05-15.
fit: Unit weight per signal; logistic negative log likelihood sum plus 2*sum(beta[1:]**2). Intercept unpenalized. Standardization from training only, standardized inputs clipped +/-5. No class rebalance, no interactions, no posthoc features.
missing: Nonfinite input => unknown; original PVR slot preserved. No imputation or dropping unknown candidates from daily K.
ranking: PVR descending, H1 descending, sid baseline; reorder only slots with finite probability and PVR, probability descending then original PVR then sid; K=min(20,N) identical.
calibration: Forward predictions only; report Brier/logloss and fixed probability bins; do not refit calibration on evaluated data.
execution_proxy: Next open/validity, zero volume and one-price next bar reported only after ranking. Not tradability proof.
big_root: First candidate per segment/I-on episode; complete60, close MFE>=30% and terminal60>=20%; early capture selected within first six common signal dates; lost and added separately.
correlation: Paired daily differences, 20-common-session block approximate CI, stock/date dependency caveat; no claim of independent 100k trials.
original_rounds: Join original PVR actual first entries to signal predictions; report unmatched, first kind, complete versus year-end complete; descriptive original-policy selected sample only.
consumed_history: 2022-2026 previously inspected. Temporal forward diagnostic, not genuinely untouched out of sample.
stop_rule: Never promote to account from this experiment. No tuning after results; failures retained.
